title: MCP for AI
intro: Claude Code and other MCP clients work with the service texts directly: they find strings, create keys and write draft translations.
step1: Save the token to the environment variable {variable} — the button copies the command with the token already in it.
step3: Start Claude Code in the project and allow the {server} server.
everywhere: In all projects at once, without a file or variable — one command. The token is saved to {file}:
copyAdd: Copy the claude mcp add command

can.search: search and read strings in any language
can.similar: find similar strings — required before creating a new key
can.tree: browse the key tree and the registry of games, sites and tests
can.create: create keys — only with a description
can.drafts: write draft translations with the “by AI” status
can.check: show untranslated strings, check placeholders and length

tokenHint: One for everyone — never commit it to a repository.
step3Hint: The {command} command will show it as connected — then just ask in plain words: “find strings about Continue in amaya-hub”.
